page_title.en: Twinsies — Count How Many & Count Out That Many (Kindergarten)
page_title.de: Gleich viele legen: Zwillingsmenge bilden – Klasse 1
page_title.fr: Autant que – compter et faire autant, en ligne (GS)
page_title.pt: Contar e fazer a mesma quantidade — duende gêmeo | 1º ano

page_intro.en: A free interactive Kindergarten counting game: the Twin-Sprite made something and wants a TWIN — not the same picture, the same MANY. Count what it made by tapping each one, then build a twin with the same number on your own plate (a different shape, so only the number matches). Tap "We're twins!" when you have just enough. Counting how many, and counting out that many, is the heart of Common Core K.CC.B.5.
page_intro.de: Zähle die Menge und lege eine gleich große Zwillingsmenge – gleich viele, nur anders angeordnet. Kostenlose, interaktive Mathe-Übung für Klasse 1. Jetzt üben!
page_intro.fr: Faire autant que le lutin jumeau : compter sa collection et préparer exactement la même quantité. Gratuit, en ligne, sans inscription.
page_intro.es: Los niños cuentan un montón y arman otro con la misma cantidad, acomodada de otra forma: actividad gratis e interactiva, sin registro, alineada a la SEP.
page_intro.pt: Ajude o duende gêmeo: conte a pilha de bolotas tocando uma a uma e faça um gêmeo com a mesma quantidade. Grátis, sem cadastro. Atividade BNCC, 1º ano.
